evidence.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/209_Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering.pdf
evidence.quote:
Given the above challenges, we propose a knowledge
graph prompting (KGP) method for enhancing LLMs in
MD-QA. Specifically, we construct a KG over the given doc-
uments with nodes symbolizing passages or document struc-
tures and edges denoting their lexical/semantic similarity be-
tween passages or intra-document structural relations. Then
for the first challenge of alternative reasoning and retrieving
knowledge across different documents, we design an LLM-
based KG traversal agent, which can alternatively generate
the next evidence to approach the question, i.e., reasoning,
and select the most promising neighbor to visit from the con-
structed KG based on the generated evidence, i.e., retrieval.
Moreover, we apply the instruction fine-tuning strategy to
augment the reasoning capability of the LLM-based KG
traversal agent and hence refrain from repeatedly prompting
non-open-sourced LLMs for evidence generation. For the
multi-modality challenge, we add different types of nodes
to the KG characterizing different document structures and
hence enabling content retrieval within those specific struc-
tures. We highlight our contributions as follows:

evidence.title: CuriousLLM: Elevating Multi-Document QA with Reasoning-Infused Knowledge Graph Prompting
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/059_CuriousLLM Elevating Multi-Document QA with Reasoning-Infused Knowledge Graph Prompting.pdf
evidence.quote:
Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved
significant success in open-domain question an-
swering. However, they continue to face chal-
lenges such as hallucinations and knowledge
cutoffs. These issues can be mitigated through
in-context learning by providing LLMs with
relevant context before generating answers.
Recent literature proposes Knowledge Graph
Prompting (KGP) which integrates knowledge
graphs with an LLM-based traversal agent
to substantially enhance document retrieval
quality. However, KGP requires costly fine-
tuning with large datasets and remains prone
to hallucination. In this paper, we propose
CuriousLLM, an enhancement that integrates
a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into
an LLM agent. This mechanism enables the
agent to generate relevant follow-up questions,
thereby guiding the information retrieval pro-
cess more efficiently. Central to our approach
is the development of the new Follow-upQA
dataset, which includes questions and support-
ing evidence as input, with follow-up ques-
tions serving as ground truths. These follow-
up questions either inquire about what is still
missing to fully answer the user’s query or
use special tokens to signify that the retrieved
evidence is sufficient. Our experiments show
that CuriousLLM significantly boosts LLM per-
formance in multi-document question answer-
ing (MD-QA), circumventing the substantial
computational costs and latency from the orig-
inal KGP framework. Source code: https:
//github.com/zukangy/KGP-CuriousLLM.
1

Curious LLM Traversal Agent
We introduce CuriousLLM as our graph traversal
agent to enhance the KGP framework. This ap-
proach is rooted in intuitive reasoning. For ex-
ample, when asked to determine who is older, Bob
Bryan or Mariaan de Swardt, and given information
about Bob’s age, one would intuitively ask a follow-
up question about Mariaan’s age. This follow-up
question guides the search for relevant informa-
tion. This intuition forms the basis of Follow-upQA
and our model’s training objective. The advan-
tage of this approach is that, although the passages
about Bob’s and Mariaan’s ages are unrelated, or,
in other words, not semantically similar, the follow-
up question about Mariaan’s age creates a logical
link between them. As a result, instead of matching
two unrelated passages, once we find one passage,
we can identify the other through follow-up ques-
tions. Furthermore, we train the LLM agent to
know when to end the search, and this early termi-
nation mechanism significantly reduces the latency
associated with the original T5 agent.

results.answer: KGP 原文提出，多文档图是在给定文档上构建的知识图谱（KG），节点表示段落或文档结构，边表示段落间的词法/语义相似度或文档内结构关系；遍历代理是“an LLM-based KG traversal agent”，它可以交替生成下一证据（推理）并从图中选择最可能访问的邻居（检索）[chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]。CuriousLLM 作者称 KGP 需要昂贵的大数据集微调且仍易幻觉，并提出“CuriousLLM, an enhancement that integrates a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into an LLM agent”，该机制让代理生成相关后续问题以引导信息检索[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。监督信号方面，CuriousLLM 作者称构建了 Follow-upQA 数据集，包含问题与支持证据作为输入、后续问题作为 ground truths；后续问题要么询问还缺什么，要么用特殊 token 表示证据已足够[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。文中还称 CuriousLLM 作为图遍历代理增强 KGP 框架，后续问题可建立语义不相似段落间的逻辑链接，并训练代理知道何时结束搜索、早停降低原 T5 代理的延迟[chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]。需区分：上述关于 KGP 机制、CuriousLLM 增强及 Follow-upQA 监督的叙述是原文作者主张；CuriousLLM 作者称实验显示其在 MD-QA 上显著提升并规避原 KGP 的计算成本与延迟，但这是作者报告的评价性说法；提供证据未给出可复核的已验证事实细节，流程证据不足以独立验证“显著提升”或“公平胜负”。

Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved
significant success in open-domain question an-
swering. However, they continue to face chal-
lenges such as hallucinations and knowledge
cutoffs. These issues can be mitigated through
in-context learning by providing LLMs with
relevant context before generating answers.
Recent literature proposes Knowledge Graph
Prompting (KGP) which integrates knowledge
graphs with an LLM-based traversal agent
to substantially enhance document retrieval
quality. However, KGP requires costly fine-
tuning with large datasets and remains prone
to hallucination. In this paper, we propose
CuriousLLM, an enhancement that integrates
a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into
an LLM agent. This mechanism enables the
agent to generate relevant follow-up questions,
thereby guiding the information retrieval pro-
cess more efficiently. Central to our approach

evidence.quote:
Knowledge Graphs (KGs) (Pan et al., 2017b,a)
usually store accurate knowledge in a structured
way. We find that a KG pattern can be viewed as
the abstract of a complex question, as shown in
Figure 1, which reveals the connection between
question planning and patterns. This opens up
the possibility of constructing training data to en-
hance the planning capabilities of LLMs using KGs.
Specifically, we start by grounding predefined pat-
terns in an open-domain KG to extract numerous
instances, which we then verbalize into complex
questions and corresponding sub-questions in nat-
ural language. In this way, we effectively create
a large number of accurate planning data for fine-
tuning. Being fine-tuned with these planning data,
LLMs’ capability of generating plans for complex
questions is enhanced, resulting in better final an-
swers by parsing and executing these plans. We
refer to this innovative framework as Learning to
Plan from Knowledge Graphs (LPKG).

Finally, we conduct
testing on our benchmark CLQA-Wiki.

results.answer: StructGPT 在回答问题时，通过为结构化数据设计的外部接口逐步收集证据，并基于所获证据进行推理；其迭代式 Reading-then-Reasoning 框架明确把“收集相关证据（reading）”与“推理答案或规划后续步骤（reasoning）”作为两项主要功能 [chunk_9f421de75aed07b68340cb2f2471a79e]。LPKG 则在训练阶段使用从知识图谱（KG）得到的规划数据来微调规划器；原文说明，用 KG 来源的规划数据微调后，CodeQwen1.5-7B-Chat 和 Llama3-8B-Instruct 的规划能力均显著提升，并称这证明了使用 KG 来源规划数据提升 LLM 规划能力的有效性 [chunk_bca043f33502bdedb273cd4b0ffe1769]。关于两者在 KG 与结构化数据角色上的差异：StructGPT 把多种结构化数据当作黑盒系统，依据其特性设计接口，以便为 LLM 提供准确、高效的数据访问和过滤 [chunk_9f421de75aed07b68340cb2f2471a79e]；而 LPKG 中的 KG 是规划训练数据的来源，原文表述为 fine-tuning is conducted on KG-sourced planning data [chunk_0bd33867fd3e8c1883e6ad37bcb38ec6]。证据未描述 LPKG 在回答阶段如何使用 KG，也未描述 StructGPT 如何用 KG 生成训练规划数据，因此这两个方面的流程证据不足，不能互相推断。

results.question: ToG 和 RoG 都利用 KG 推理，为什么不能据此把两者都归为免训练方法？分别追踪 KG 在在线搜索和训练中的作用。
results.answer: ToG 被作者明确称为“training-free”方法：原文称 ToG 是训练无关的提示方法，并且是以无额外训练成本的即插即用框架；其 KG 作用是在线让 LLM 作为 agent 在 KG 上迭代执行 beam search、发现推理路径并返回结果 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2][chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790]。RoG 则不是免训练：作者说 RoG 通过两个任务优化，其中规划优化把 KG 知识蒸馏进 LLM 以生成关系路径，检索-推理优化让 LLM 基于检索到的路径推理 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]。RoG 的 KG 在推理时用于按规划模块生成的关系路径检索有效推理路径，同时 KG 结构也用于指导推理与解释 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]。因此不能因两者都利用 KG 推理就把它们都归为免训练方法：证据只直接支持 ToG 为免训练，RoG 的证据直接描述了训练优化过程 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2][chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]。

evidence.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs
with KGs to conduct faithful and interpretable reasoning. To alleviate the issues of hallucinations
and lack of knowledge, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first gen-
erates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans via the planning module. These plans are
then used to retrieve valid reasoning paths from KGs to conduct faithful reasoning by the retrieval-
reasoning module. In this way, we not only retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider
the guidance of KG structure for reasoning and explanations. Moreover, the planning module of RoG
can be plug-and-play with different LLMs during inference to improve their performance. Based on
this framework, RoG is optimized by two tasks: 1) planning optimization, where we distill knowl-
edge from KGs into LLMs to generate faithful relation paths as plans; and 2) retrieval-reasoning
optimization, where we enable LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning based on retrieved paths and gen-
erate interpretable results. We conduct extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets,
and the results demonstrate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks
and generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results.
2

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/215_Think-on-Graph Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model with Knowledge Graph.pdf
evidence.quote:
ABSTRACT
Although large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant success in vari-
ous tasks, they often struggle with hallucination problems, especially in scenarios
requiring deep and responsible reasoning. These issues could be partially addressed
by introducing external knowledge graphs (KG) in LLM reasoning. In this paper,
we propose a new LLM-KG integrating paradigm “LLM ⊗KG” which treats the
LLM as an agent to interactively explore related entities and relations on KGs
and perform reasoning based on the retrieved knowledge. We further implement
this paradigm by introducing a new approach called Think-on-Graph (ToG), in
which the LLM agent iteratively executes beam search on KG, discovers the most
promising reasoning paths, and returns the most likely reasoning results. We use
a number of well-designed experiments to examine and illustrate the following
advantages of ToG: 1) compared with LLMs, ToG has better deep reasoning power;
2) ToG has the ability of knowledge traceability and knowledge correctability by
leveraging LLMs reasoning and expert feedback; 3) ToG provides a flexible plug-
and-play framework for different LLMs, KGs and prompting strategies without
any additional training cost; 4) the performance of ToG with small LLM models
could exceed large LLM such as GPT-4 in certain scenarios and this reduces the
cost of LLM deployment and application. As a training-free method with lower
computational cost and better generality, ToG achieves overall SOTA in 6 out of
9 datasets where most previous SOTAs rely on additional training. Our code is
publicly available at https://github.com/IDEA-FinAI/ToG.

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
The most relevant works to ToG-2 are hybrid RAG approaches that aim to integrate both KGs and un-
structured data with LLM, leveraging the strengths of both to mitigate their respective weaknesses.
Chain-of-Knowledge (Li et al., 2024c) (CoK) is a hybrid RAG method that retrieves knowledge
from Wikipedia, Wikidata and Wikitable to ground LLMs’ outputs. GraphRAG (Edge et al., 2024)
establishes a KG from documents and enables KG-enhanced text retrieval. HybridRAG (Sarmah
et al., 2024) retrieves information from both vector databases and KGs, achieving superior reason-
ing performance compared to either text-based RAG or KG-based RAG methods alone. However,
existing hybrid RAG approaches merely aggregate information retrieved from KGs and texts but do
not improve the retrieval results on one knowledge source through the other. In this work, ToG-2
aims to tightly couple KG-based RAG and text-based RAG methods, enabling both in-depth context
retrieval and precise graph retrieval to enhance complex reasoning performances of LLMs.

results.question: ToG 和 RoG 都利用 KG 推理，为什么不能据此把两者都归为免训练方法？分别追踪 KG 在在线搜索和训练中的作用。
results.answer: ToG 明确被作者称为无需训练的 prompting 方法：原文说“even if ToG is a training-free prompting-based method”，并描述其在实验中直接使用 ChatGPT、GPT-4 与 Llama-2 等骨干模型进行即插即用式调用 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。RoG 则不是免训练方法：作者提出规划-检索-推理框架，并说明 RoG 通过两个任务进行优化，其中规划优化把 KG 知识蒸馏进 LLM 以生成关系路径，检索-推理优化让 LLM 基于检索到的路径进行推理 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]。因此，RoG 的 KG 在训练阶段参与优化（蒸馏与检索-推理优化），而 ToG 的 KG 主要用于推理阶段的在线搜索：原文描述 ToG 的实验设置中宽度 N 和深度 Dmax 设为 3 用于 beam search，并设置探索与推理过程的温度参数 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]；但就“在线搜索中 KG 如何被逐跳查询”的具体流程，现有证据仅有 beam search 参数与所用 KG（Freebase/Wikidata），流程证据不足 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。关于 ToG-2 的证据只说明其迭代协作检索且“without additional training costs”，不能用来证明 ToG 或 RoG 的训练属性 [chunk_44ca1868cc8294f6cfe2d5991cbd0d4b]。

evidence.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs
with KGs to conduct faithful and interpretable reasoning. To alleviate the issues of hallucinations
and lack of knowledge, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first gen-
erates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans via the planning module. These plans are
then used to retrieve valid reasoning paths from KGs to conduct faithful reasoning by the retrieval-
reasoning module. In this way, we not only retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider
the guidance of KG structure for reasoning and explanations. Moreover, the planning module of RoG
can be plug-and-play with different LLMs during inference to improve their performance. Based on
this framework, RoG is optimized by two tasks: 1) planning optimization, where we distill knowl-
edge from KGs into LLMs to generate faithful relation paths as plans; and 2) retrieval-reasoning
optimization, where we enable LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning based on retrieved paths and gen-
erate interpretable results. We conduct extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets,
and the results demonstrate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks
and generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results.
2

evidence.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.
10

results.question: 比较 ToG-2 与 LPKG：图知识分别怎样帮助文档证据检索和问题规划？说明二者发生在训练还是推理阶段。
results.answer: ToG-2 方面：其优势包括在知识图谱（KG）引导下实现深入、可靠的上下文检索，并把文档作为节点上下文来进行精确的图检索，从而把 KG 与文本 RAG 紧密耦合[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；它被明确描述为无需训练、即插即用的框架[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]。LPKG 方面：其框架先利用 KG 中丰富的模式构建规划数据，再基于这些数据微调规划 LLM，使其能对下游数据集进行问题规划[chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]；原文还提到“During the fine-tuning phase of planning LLMs”，即规划模型的微调阶段[chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]。由此可见，LPKG 对 KG 的利用发生在建数据与训练（微调）阶段；ToG-2 检索阶段的 KG 利用发生在推理期（训练免费）。两者在训练与推理阶段的归属不同，原文没有给出二者在同一设置下的直接可比结果。

evidence.quote:
The advantage of ToG-2 can be summarized as: (1) In-depth retrieval: ToG-2 achieves in-depth
and reliable context retrieval through the guide of KGs and performs precise graph retrieval by
treating documents as node contexts, achieving a tight-coupling combination of KG and text RAG,
enabling deep and comprehensive retrieval processes. (2) Faithful reasoning: ToG-2 iteratively
performs a collaborative retrieval process based on KG and text, using retrieved heterogeneous
knowledge as the basis for LLM reasoning and enhancing the faithfulness of LLM-generated con-
tent (3) Efficiency and Effectiveness: a) ToG-2 is a training-free and plug-and-play framework that
can be applied to various LLMs; b) ToG-2 can be executed between any associated KG and docu-
ment database, while for purely document database, entities can be extracted from the documents
first, and then a graph can be constructed through relation extraction or entity co-occurrence (Edge
et al., 2024); c) ToG-2 achieves new SOTA performances on various complex knowledge reasoning
datasets and can elevate the reasoning capabilities of smaller LLMs, e.g., Llama2-13B to a level
comparable to direct reasoning with powerful LLMs like GPT-3.5.

Conclusion
In this paper, we try to enhance the planning ability
in retrieval-augmented LLMs using KGs. Specifi-
cally, we design a framework for Learning to Plan
from KG (LPKG). The proposed LPKG framework
first utilizes the rich patterns in the KGs to con-
struct planning data, then fine-tune planning LLMs
based on such data to enable them to conduct plan-
ning on downstream datasets, and ultimately get
the final answer through parsing and execution.
The experimental results reveal the excellent per-
formance of the LPKG framework and also demon-
strate the effectiveness of using KG-sourced data to
enhance LLMs’ planning ability. Finally, we con-
struct CLQA-Wiki, providing a more challenging
complex QA benchmark for the community.

Figure 4: Fine-grained evaluation based on question types.
Limitation
In our view, the limitations of our work at the cur-
rent stage mainly stem from two aspects:
(1) During the fine-tuning phase of planning
LLMs, we simply mixed various types of ques-
tions together uniformly for training. We have not
yet explored the impact of question type distribu-
tion on the experimental results, which could be
the focus of future work.
(2) At present, the datasets we test have explicit
types of questions (multi-hop, comparison, and
union/intersection), but in reality, some question
types may be implicit or even not be included in
the types we define. The future direction of our
work can be to study planning methods for these
types of unclear questions.

The manual analysis results presented in Table 5 reveal several additional observations:
1) Even though ToG-2 consistently outperforms the baselines across various datasets, it still faces
significant bottlenecks when it comes to information retrieval. These issues are largely due to in-
complete knowledge sources and the limitations of retrieval models. For instance, Wikidata often
contains inaccuracies, contradictions, or gaps, and many Wiki entities are missing key details on
their Wikipedia pages. On the retrieval side, different types of questions require different informa-

results.answer: ToG-2 方面，原文称其“through the guide of KGs”实现“in-depth and reliable context retrieval”，并把文档作为节点上下文进行“precise graph retrieval”，即以图知识引导文档证据检索；同时原文声明 ToG-2 是“training-free and plug-and-play framework”，说明该检索机制发生在推理阶段 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]。LPKG 方面，原文称其“first utilizes the rich patterns in the KGs to construct planning data, then fine-tune planning LLMs based on such data”，即图知识用于构造规划数据并在微调阶段增强规划能力，随后才在下游数据集执行规划 [chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]。因此，按原文表述，ToG-2 的图引导检索用于推理阶段的文档证据检索，LPKG 的图来源数据用于训练阶段的规划微调；关于两者在“问题规划”上对文档检索的直接作用如何逐项对应，现有证据不足以做更细的对比，属流程证据不足。

rent stage mainly stem from two aspects:

results.question: G-Retriever 与 ToG-2 都用图帮助获取上下文，但它们选择证据的机制怎样不同？分别连接输入规模问题、相关子图选择以及实体和文档的协作。
results.answer: ToG-2 的机制是知识图谱与文本紧耦合、迭代交替检索：它“leverages knowledge graphs (KGs) to link documents via entities, facilitating deep and knowledge-guided context retrieval”，同时“utilizes documents as entity contexts to achieve precise and efficient graph retrieval”，并在图检索与上下文检索之间交替搜索线索[chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]。其优势还表述为以KG指导深度可靠上下文检索、把文档作为节点上下文进行精确图检索，从而“tight-coupling combination of KG and text RAG”[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]。关于G-Retriever如何选择相关子图、如何协调实体与文档，所给证据只有结果表及对检索前后效率的表题陈述，缺少方法流程描述，因此G-Retriever的选择机制证据不足[chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。输入规模问题方面，证据未给出ToG-2或G-Retriever针对输入规模的机制说明；仅G-Retriever表题称“Retrieval on graphs significantly improves efficiency”并比较检索前后平均值，但不能据此推断其子图选择流程[chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。因此两种机制的系统性差异无法在现有证据下完整比较，G-Retriever侧为缺口。

(LLMs) by using knowledge retrieval to overcome knowledge deficiencies. How-
ever, current RAG methods often fall short of ensuring the depth and complete-
ness of retrieved information, which is necessary for complex reasoning tasks.
In this work, we introduce Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2), a hybrid RAG frame-
work that iteratively retrieves information from both unstructured and structured

Specifically, ToG-2 leverages

knowledge-guided context retrieval. Simultaneously, it utilizes documents as en-

deepening context retrieval via the KG while enabling reliable graph retrieval
based on contexts; 2) it achieves deep and faithful reasoning in LLMs through
an iterative knowledge retrieval process of collaboration between contexts and
the KG; and 3) ToG-2 is training-free and plug-and-play compatible with vari-

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has improved large language models
(LLMs) by using knowledge retrieval to overcome knowledge deficiencies. How-
ever, current RAG methods often fall short of ensuring the depth and complete-
ness of retrieved information, which is necessary for complex reasoning tasks.
In this work, we introduce Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2), a hybrid RAG frame-
work that iteratively retrieves information from both unstructured and structured
knowledge sources in a tight-coupling manner.

knowledge graphs (KGs) to link documents via entities, facilitating deep and
knowledge-guided context retrieval. Simultaneously, it utilizes documents as en-

between graph retrieval and context retrieval to search for in-depth clues rele-

Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the

CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.

results.question: 从 ToG 与 ToG-2 的评测段落出发，找出共同使用的 WebQSP 与 QALD10-en，分别给出“方法→数据集”的来源，再说明为什么这个连接不能证明优劣或继承。
results.answer: ToG 的方法段落明确把 WebQSP 与 QALD10-en 列为实验数据集：原文称 Freebase 用于 CWQ、WebQSP、GrailQA、Simple Questions 和 Webquestions，而 Wikidata 用于 QALD10-en [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。ToG-2 则在结果讨论中列出 WebQSP、AdvHotpotQA、QALD-10-en 和 Zero-Shot RE 上的表现，并称前三者为多跳推理数据集 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。但“两者都使用这两个数据集”不能证明优劣或继承：ToG-2 的结果段只报告其相对基线的提升，未说明与 ToG 在这些数据集上的可比实验条件 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]；ToG 的评测段也未给出与 ToG-2 相同设置下的对照 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。因此共同数据集只表明共同评测对象，原文证据不足以支持谁更优或方法继承关系。

results.answer: 按指定路径可核对到两篇都涉及 MetaQA，但“跳数与指标”的直接证据并不对称：RoG 文内只给出 MetaQA-3hop 的统计与来源，KG-GPT 给出 MetaQA 1/2/3-hop 的 Hits@1 结果；因此不能据现有原文做同跳数、同指标的可比胜负判断。就 RoG 的两个知识来源而言，Freebase 是 WebQSP、CWQ 的背景知识图谱 [chunk_229cb41ae3582cc199c9ee25c4956269]，而 Wiki-Movies 是 MetaQA-3hop 所基于的知识图谱，RoG 从中选取 1000 个训练样本 [chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。原文还分别列出 Freebase 与 Wiki-Movie 的统计表 [chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。KG-GPT 的 MetaQA 结果是 Hits@1，但所给片段未说明其知识来源角色，流程证据不足 [chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]。

EXPERIMENT
In our experiments, we aim to answer the following research questions: RQ1: Can RoG achieve
state-of-the-art performance on the KGQA tasks? RQ2: Can the planning module of RoG be inte-
grated with other LLMs to improve their performance? RQ3: Can RoG conduct faithful reasoning
and generate interpretable reasoning results?
5.1
EXPERIMENT SETTINGS
Datasets. We evaluate the reasoning ability of RoG on two benchmark KGQA datasets: WebQues-

which contain up to 4-hop questions. Freebase (Bollacker et al., 2008) is the background knowledge
graph for both datasets, which contains around 88 million entities, 20 thousand relations, and 126
million triples. The details of the datasets are described in Appendix A.4.

EXPERIMENT
In our experiments, we aim to answer the following research questions: RQ1: Can RoG achieve
state-of-the-art performance on the KGQA tasks? RQ2: Can the planning module of RoG be inte-
grated with other LLMs to improve their performance? RQ3: Can RoG conduct faithful reasoning
and generate interpretable reasoning results?
5.1
EXPERIMENT SETTINGS
Datasets. We evaluate the reasoning ability of RoG on two benchmark KGQA datasets: WebQues-
tionSP (WebQSP) (Yih et al., 2016) and Complex WebQuestions (CWQ) (Talmor & Berant, 2018),
which contain up to 4-hop questions. Freebase (Bollacker et al., 2008) is the background knowledge
graph for both datasets, which contains around 88 million entities, 20 thousand relations, and 126
million triples. The details of the datasets are described in Appendix A.4.

results.answer: RoG 原文明确：MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies KG；构造的知识图谱统计中，Wiki-Movie 有 43,234 个实体、9 种关系、133,582 条三元组，Freebase 有 2,566,291 个实体、7,058 种关系、8,309,195 条三元组[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。作者还写“To evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs”，但该引句未点名 Freebase 或 Wiki-Movies 的角色，因此不能据此把 Freebase 判作源域、Wiki-Movies 判作迁移域[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。就角色而言，原文证据只支持 Wiki-Movies 是 MetaQA-3hop 所基于的 KG；对 Freebase 只给出 KG 统计，未见把它说明为 RoG 在 MetaQA 实验中的知识来源[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。跳数与指标：RoG 引用 MetaQA-3hop 的 #hop=3，但其提供的表格引句只列训练/测试规模和跳数，未列出 MetaQA 各跳的指标定义或结果；故不能从该证据比较两篇的 MetaQA 指标[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。KG-GPT 原文表 2 标题写明 MetaQA 指标为 Hits@1，并按 1-hop/2-hop/3-hop 分列 KG-GPT 得分[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]。但 KG-GPT 证据未描述其 MetaQA 知识来源是 Freebase 还是 Wiki-Movies，故该角色证据不足；因此两篇在“知识来源”上不可直接对照[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]。

evidence.quote:
Experiment
We conduct experiments on three complex rea-
soning tasks over structured data, i.e., KGQA,
TableQA, and DB based text-to-SQL.
5.1
Datasets
For KG based QA (KGQA), we adopt two
benchmark datasets, i.e., WebQuestionsSP (We-
bQSP) (Yih et al., 2016) and MetaQA (Zhang et al.,
2018) for evaluation. The answer entities in We-
bQSP require up to 2-hop reasoning on the Free-
base KG. In contrast, MetaQA contains questions
in the movie domain, whose answer entities are up
to 3 hops away from the topic entities on a movie
KG (based on OMDb). According to the num-
ber of hops, it is split into three sub-datasets, i.e.,
MetaQA-1hop, MetaQA-2hop, and MetaQA-3hop.
For Table based QA (TableQA), we adopt
three widely-used datasets, weakly-supervised Wik-
iSQL (WikiSQL) (Zhong et al., 2017), WikiTable-
Questions (WTQ) (Pasupat and Liang, 2015), and
TabFact (Chen et al., 2020). The first two are typ-
ical table-based question answering datasets, and
the third one is a multiple-choice dataset that con-
centrates on table fact verification. WikiSQL re-
quires filtering and aggregating information over
the table content, and the WTQ demands more
advanced reasoning capabilities (e.g., sorting). Tab-
Fact needs to judge whether the provided statement
agrees with the facts stored in a table.

results.answer: RoG 中，Freebase 是主训练用的大规模 KG：构造知识图谱统计表列出 Freebase 的 #Entities 2,566,291、#Relations 7,058、#Triples 8,309,195 [chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。Wiki-Movies 是迁移评测所用的 KG：原文称选择基于 Wiki-Movies KGs 的 MetaQA-3hop 数据集，并采用“transfer from Freebase”策略微调 RoG [chunk_f5c88d605f651f26c093f30b836a98aa]。同一表还列出 Wiki-Movie 的 #Entities 43,234、#Relations 9、#Triples 133,582 [chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d]。两篇实验的比较方面：KG-GPT 在 MetaQA 上按 1-hop/2-hop/3-hop 报告 Hits@1，例如 8-shot KG-GPT 为 95.8/93.8/68.8 [chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]；RoG 的该部分原文给出的是 MetaQA-3hop 迁移设置与训练/迁移时间，未在提供的引句中给出可直接对齐的 1-hop/2-hop/3-hop 指标数值，因此指标口径与跳数覆盖不可直接比较 [chunk_f5c88d605f651f26c093f30b836a98aa]。知识来源上，KG-GPT 引句未说明 MetaQA 基于哪个 KG；RoG 明确 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies [chunk_f5c88d605f651f26c093f30b836a98aa]。

results.question: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 与 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 怎样分别连接到知识来源？虽然都涉及 Wikidata，二者考察的关系推理能力有何区别？
results.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 需要同时使用 MusicBrainz 和 Wikidata 两个知识图谱：原文称该数据集“containing 109 questions that require reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata”，并称其“synthesizing and reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources” [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 则从 Wikidata 的一个子集构建：“we construct a Comprehensive Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a subset of Wikidata (Vrandedinc and Krötzsch, 2014) via grounding rich patterns as aforementioned” [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。就关系推理能力而言，MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 考察的是跨两个来源的知识图谱信息综合推理：“to test the reasoning ability using multiple KGs” [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；CLQA-Wiki 明确覆盖多种逻辑操作类型：“The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly covers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union types of questions” [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。因此，据所给证据，可确认前者强调跨知识图谱综合，后者强调多跳、比较、交集与并集等逻辑运算；证据未给出两者在同一协议下的直接对比，不能据此判断谁更难或胜负。

Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

results.question: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 与 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 怎样分别连接到知识来源？虽然都涉及 Wikidata，二者考察的关系推理能力有何区别？
results.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 数据集包含需同时从 MusicBrainz 和 Wikidata 两个知识图谱获取信息并推理的 109 个问题，专门测试多知识图谱推理能力 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 则从 Wikidata 子集构建，通过 grounding rich patterns 生成，均匀覆盖多跳、比较、交集和并集类型的逻辑问题 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。因此前者考察跨多个知识图谱来源的综合推理，后者考察单一 Wikidata 来源上的复杂逻辑操作推理 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6][chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。

Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

results.answer: 两条证据只说明两个基准分属不同论文的方法设置，不能据此建立 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的继承或直接可比关系。ToG-2 的结果表将 AdvHotpotQA 标为多跳推理数据集，并以 EM 报告 ToG-2 的成绩与 CoK 等方法的比较 [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]；HippoRAG 一侧的检索结果表把 HotpotQA 与 MuSiQue、2Wiki 并列，报告 recall@2/recall@5，并称其在 HotpotQA 上表现相当 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]。两处证据均未给出 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的构造关系、数据划分或评测协议对齐，因此检索流程证据不足，不能用 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 数字与 HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 数字直接比较胜负 [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df][chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]。

performs other baselines on WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, and Zero-Shot RE. Notably,
WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA and QALD-10-en are multi-hop reasoning datasets. On Fever, ToG-2 has
a competitive performance to CoK since the fact statements in Fever mainly are about single-hop
relations and thus do not need in-depth information retrieval. In another fact verification dataset

results.question: HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是什么关系？引用两篇的设置说明，判断能否直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法。
results.answer: 无法确认二者是同一数据集或可直接对应：ToG-2 的表格把 AdvHotpotQA 作为数据集列出，并用 EM 报告结果 [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]；HippoRAG 的结果讨论则称其在 HotpotQA 上报告 F1，并说明其与 IRCoT 使用相同 QA reader [chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674]。ToG-2 的设置说明强调，AdvHotpotQA 和 FEVER 采用 CoK 原论文报告的结果，并区分 3-shot 与 6-shot [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]；其主结果表以 GPT-3.5-turbo 为底座进行比较 [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]，另有按 Llama-3-8B、Qwen2-7B、GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o 分别报告 AdvHotpotQA 的结果 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。HippoRAG 的引句只说明 HotpotQA 的 F1 改进幅度及与 IRCoT 使用同一 QA reader [chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674]，未给出与 AdvHotpotQA 的对应关系，也未说明与 ToG-2 相同的底座模型、shot 设置或评测协议。因此，按现有原文证据，不能直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法；二者关系与可比条件证据不足。

results.question: HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是什么关系？引用两篇的设置说明，判断能否直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法。
results.answer: HippoRAG 的实验结论是在 HotpotQA（原文写作 HotpotQA）上报告 QA 结果，并将其与 ColBERTv2、IRCoT 等检索基线比较，使用的是同一 QA reader 条件[chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674]。ToG-2 则是在 AdvHotpotQA 上报告结果，表 1 以 GPT-3.5-turbo 为统一底座比较不同方法，AdvHotpotQA 指标为 EM[chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]；另有表按 Llama-3-8B、Qwen2-7B、GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o 分别列出 ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上的得分[chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。两条证据只表明二者分别涉及 HotpotQA 与 AdvHotpotQA，并未说明 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的构造关系、数据划分或评测协议是否一致；因此仅凭所给原文，无法判断可直接用两者结果数字比较两种检索方法，流程与可比性证据不足。

WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA and QALD-10-en are multi-hop reasoning datasets. On Fever, ToG-2 has

results.question: 比较 KG-GPT 与 RoG：句子分割、图检索、关系路径规划分别属于哪套流程？把输入到证据再到推理的顺序写清楚。
results.answer: KG-GPT 的流程按原文分为三阶段：句子分割、图检索、推理；其中句子分割采用分而治之，把一个句子拆成对应单一关系的子句 [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c]，证据图 GE⊂G 由句子分割和图检索两个阶段获得 [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c]，结论性表述也确认三阶段为 Sentence Segmentation、Graph Retrieval、Inference [chunk_45c598ca774c47ab2be0c3b734efd4de]。因此，输入到证据再到推理的顺序是：输入句子/声明或问题→句子分割→图检索得到证据图→推理得出结论 [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c][chunk_45c598ca774c47ab2be0c3b734efd4de]。关于 RoG：现有证据只说明 RoG 与 21 个基线比较，并把基线分为嵌入方法、检索增强方法、语义解析方法、LLM、LLM+KG 五类 [chunk_813477b074abcc4657cb828fdd775b2b]，未找到 RoG 自身句子分割、图检索或关系路径规划流程的描述，因此这些环节属于哪套流程证据不足，无法与 KG-GPT 逐项比较。

We compare RoG with 21 baselines grouping into 5 categories: 1) Embedding-based methods, 2)

Embedding-based methods.

process.

tween entities and questions for reasoning.

erates answers based on the input question.
Retrieval-augmented methods.
• GraftNet (Sun et al., 2018) retrieves relevant subgraphs from KGs with entity linking.
• PullNet (Sun et al., 2019) trains a retrieval model composed of a LSTM and a graph neural
network to retrieve a question-specific subgraph.

evidence.quote:
Conclusion
We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,
Graph Retrieval, and Inference, each designed for
breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph
elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes, respec-
tively. We assess KG-GPT’s efficacy using KG-
based fact verification and KGQA metrics, and
the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-
sults, even surpassing a number of fully-supervised
models. Consequently, our research signifies a sub-
stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

results.question: 比较 KG-GPT 与 RoG：句子分割、图检索、关系路径规划分别属于哪套流程？把输入到证据再到推理的顺序写清楚。
results.answer: KG-GPT 明确分为三阶段：句子分割、图检索与推理（Inference），这一流程在原文中有直接说明。[chunk_45c598ca774c47ab2be0c3b734efd4de][chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c] KG-GPT 的方法描述指出，它由 Sentence Segmentation、Graph Retrieval 与 Inference 三阶段组成，并以图 G、句子 S 及句中实体为输入，先经句子分割与图检索得到证据图 GE，再进行推理。[chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c] 其中句子分割采用分而治之，把一个句子拆成对应单一关系的子句；图检索阶段则承接句子分割的结果。[chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c] 关于 RoG，证据只出现在 RoG 论文的基线说明段落中，且该段落是在列举基线类别与方法，并未描述 RoG 自身的句子分割、图检索或关系路径规划流程。[chunk_813477b074abcc4657cb828fdd775b2b] 因此，无法根据所给原文对两套流程逐项做对应比较：RoG 的流程证据不足，关系路径规划更未在证据中出现。所谓“输入到证据再到推理”的顺序，目前只有 KG-GPT 有原文支持；RoG 的这一顺序缺少方法描述，不能从基线段落推断。

results.question: 比较 KG-GPT 与 RoG：句子分割、图检索、关系路径规划分别属于哪套流程？把输入到证据再到推理的顺序写清楚。
results.answer: KG-GPT 的流程在原文中被明确分为三阶段：句子分割、图检索、推理/推断。KG-GPT 的方法描述称“KG-GPT is composed of three stages: Sentence Segmentation, Graph Retrieval, and Inference” [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c]；结论段同样称三阶段分别用于“breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes” [chunk_45c598ca774c47ab2be0c3b734efd4de]。其中句子分割被描述为把句子分解为对应单一关系的子句，图检索用于获得证据图，随后进行推理 [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c]。因此按原文，KG-GPT 的顺序是：输入句子/主张或问题→句子分割→图检索取得证据图→推理得出结论 [chunk_e702747b8cb7850698f65ab65a3d7d8c]。关于 RoG，所给证据只说明 RoG 与 21 个基线比较并被归入分组，列出的是其他基线的描述，未描述 RoG 自身的句子分割、图检索或关系路径规划流程 [chunk_813477b074abcc4657cb828fdd775b2b]。因此，无法据现有证据判定 RoG 是否包含这三步、其先后顺序为何，也无法完成与 KG-GPT 的逐项流程对应；RoG 侧流程证据不足 [chunk_813477b074abcc4657cb828fdd775b2b]。

Conclusion
We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,
Graph Retrieval, and Inference, each designed for
breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph
elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes, respec-
tively. We assess KG-GPT’s efficacy using KG-
based fact verification and KGQA metrics, and
the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-
sults, even surpassing a number of fully-supervised
models. Consequently, our research signifies a sub-
stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

results.answer: ToG：将“LLM 逐步探索图”作为方法。原文以流程图说明每轮从中心实体开始搜索、由 LLM 评分剪枝，并把束搜索得到的 top-N 推理路径作为多跳推理基础 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]。多跳关联发生在图搜索过程中，即 LLM 在每轮迭代探索/剪枝实体与关系后再继续下一轮 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]。HippoRAG：据所给片段只能确认其用关联图做知识整合、区别于迭代式多步 RAG [chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]；但“查询种子驱动图算法”的具体流程在所给证据中描述不足，不能从这些摘录确定多跳关联发生的具体步骤 [chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。RoG：先规划关系路径再取证。原文的 planning module 旨在为回答问题生成可靠的关系路径计划，并将问题与指令模板输入 LLM 生成关系路径 [chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]；计划优化与检索-推理优化共同构成最终目标 [chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]。多跳关联发生在先由规划模块生成关系路径计划、再据检索到的推理路径进行检索-推理的阶段 [chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]。

The advantage of ToG can be abbreviated as (1) Deep reasoning: ToG extracts diverse and multi-
hop reasoning paths from KGs as the basis for LLM reasoning, enhancing LLMs’ deep reasoning
capabilities for knowledge-intensive tasks. (2) Responsible reasoning: Explicit, editable reasoning
paths improve the explainability of the reasoning process of LLMs, and enable the tracing and

framework, knowledge can be updated frequently via KG instead of LLM whose knowledge-update

Figure 1: Knowledge Integration & RAG. Tasks that require knowledge integration are particularly
challenging for current RAG systems. In the above example, we want to find a Stanford professor
that does Alzheimer’s research from a pool of passages describing potentially thousands Stanford
professors and Alzheimer’s researchers. Since current methods encode passages in isolation, they
would struggle to identify Prof. Thomas unless a passage mentions both characteristics at once. In

associative memory capabilities, thought to be driven by the index structure depicted in the C-shaped
hippocampus above (in blue). Inspired by this mechanism, HippoRAG allows LLMs to build and
leverage a similar graph of associations to tackle knowledge integration tasks.
standard multi-hop question answering (QA) also requires integrating information between passages

retrieval and LLM generation steps iteratively to join disparate passages [64, 78]. Nevertheless, even
perfectly executed multi-step RAG is still oftentimes insufficient to accomplish many scenarios of
knowledge integration, as we illustrate in what we call path-finding multi-hop questions in Figure 1.

results.question: 在 ToG、HippoRAG 与 RoG 中，分别找出“LLM 逐步探索图”“查询种子驱动图算法”“先规划关系路径再取证”的方法。每项给出一篇原文，并比较多跳关联发生在哪一步。
results.answer: ToG：原文把 ToG 的工作流描述为从中心实体出发、按迭代（深度）搜索，并用 beam search 汇总 top-N 推理路径，属于“LLM 逐步探索图”的证据；多跳关联发生在逐轮实体/关系搜索与剪枝、路径汇总阶段 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]。HippoRAG：所给原文只说明受海马索引结构启发构建关联图以做知识整合，并指出现有RAG用多步检索与生成迭代连接段落；没有给出“查询种子驱动图算法”的流程描述，流程证据不足 [chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。RoG：所给原文仅称关系路径对提升LLM复杂问题推理重要，并报告不同跳数上的性能；没有给出“先规划关系路径再取证”的方法步骤，方法流程证据不足 [chunk_853c2cdb088533bc71f93f42690919ae]。比较多跳关联发生步骤：仅ToG有可核对的分步图搜索与路径汇总描述；HippoRAG与RoG缺少相应流程证据，无法按同一层次比较 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3][chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c][chunk_853c2cdb088533bc71f93f42690919ae]。

professors and Alzheimer’s researchers. Since current methods encode passages in isolation, they
would struggle to identify Prof. Thomas unless a passage mentions both characteristics at once. In
contrast, most people familiar with this professor would remember him quickly due to our brain’s
associative memory capabilities, thought to be driven by the index structure depicted in the C-shaped
hippocampus above (in blue). Inspired by this mechanism, HippoRAG allows LLMs to build and
leverage a similar graph of associations to tackle knowledge integration tasks.
standard multi-hop question answering (QA) also requires integrating information between passages
in a retrieval corpus. In order to solve such tasks, current RAG systems resort to using multiple
retrieval and LLM generation steps iteratively to join disparate passages [64, 78]. Nevertheless, even
perfectly executed multi-step RAG is still oftentimes insufficient to accomplish many scenarios of
knowledge integration, as we illustrate in what we call path-finding multi-hop questions in Figure 1.

The advantage of ToG-2 can be summarized as: (1) In-depth retrieval: ToG-2 achieves in-depth
and reliable context retrieval through the guide of KGs and performs precise graph retrieval by
treating documents as node contexts, achieving a tight-coupling combination of KG and text RAG,
enabling deep and comprehensive retrieval processes. (2) Faithful reasoning: ToG-2 iteratively
performs a collaborative retrieval process based on KG and text, using retrieved heterogeneous
knowledge as the basis for LLM reasoning and enhancing the faithfulness of LLM-generated con-
tent (3) Efficiency and Effectiveness: a) ToG-2 is a training-free and plug-and-play framework that
can be applied to various LLMs; b) ToG-2 can be executed between any associated KG and docu-
ment database, while for purely document database, entities can be extracted from the documents
first, and then a graph can be constructed through relation extraction or entity co-occurrence (Edge
et al., 2024); c) ToG-2 achieves new SOTA performances on various complex knowledge reasoning

evidence.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/035_HippoRAG Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models.pdf
evidence.quote:
Abstract
In order to thrive in hostile and ever-changing natural environments, mammalian
brains evolved to store large amounts of knowledge about the world and continually
integrate new information while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Despite their
impressive accomplishments, large language models (LLMs), even with retrieval-
augmented generation (RAG), still struggle to efficiently and effectively integrate
a large amount of new experiences after pre-training. In this work, we introduce
HippoRAG, a novel retrieval framework inspired by the hippocampal indexing
theory of human long-term memory to enable deeper and more efficient knowledge
integration over new experiences. HippoRAG synergistically orchestrates LLMs,
knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm to mimic the different
roles of neocortex and hippocampus in human memory. We compare HippoRAG
with existing RAG methods on multi-hop question answering (QA) and show that
our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods remarkably, by up to 20%.
Single-step retrieval with HippoRAG achieves comparable or better performance
than iterative retrieval like IRCoT while being 10-20 times cheaper and 6-13 times
faster, and integrating HippoRAG into IRCoT brings further substantial gains.
Finally, we show that our method can tackle new types of scenarios that are out of
reach of existing methods.1
1

evidence.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
The most relevant works to ToG-2 are hybrid RAG approaches that aim to integrate both KGs and un-
structured data with LLM, leveraging the strengths of both to mitigate their respective weaknesses.
Chain-of-Knowledge (Li et al., 2024c) (CoK) is a hybrid RAG method that retrieves knowledge
from Wikipedia, Wikidata and Wikitable to ground LLMs’ outputs. GraphRAG (Edge et al., 2024)
establishes a KG from documents and enables KG-enhanced text retrieval. HybridRAG (Sarmah
et al., 2024) retrieves information from both vector databases and KGs, achieving superior reason-
ing performance compared to either text-based RAG or KG-based RAG methods alone. However,
existing hybrid RAG approaches merely aggregate information retrieved from KGs and texts but do
not improve the retrieval results on one knowledge source through the other. In this work, ToG-2
aims to tightly couple KG-based RAG and text-based RAG methods, enabling both in-depth context
retrieval and precise graph retrieval to enhance complex reasoning performances of LLMs.
3

evidence.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.

citations.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
citations.quote:
CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.

brains evolved to store large amounts of knowledge about the world and continually

augmented generation (RAG), still struggle to efficiently and effectively integrate

theory of human long-term memory to enable deeper and more efficient knowledge

treating documents as node contexts, achieving a tight-coupling combination of KG and text RAG,
enabling deep and comprehensive retrieval processes. (2) Faithful reasoning: ToG-2 iteratively
performs a collaborative retrieval process based on KG and text, using retrieved heterogeneous
knowledge as the basis for LLM reasoning and enhancing the faithfulness of LLM-generated con-
tent (3) Efficiency and Effectiveness: a) ToG-2 is a training-free and plug-and-play framework that
can be applied to various LLMs; b) ToG-2 can be executed between any associated KG and docu-
ment database, while for purely document database, entities can be extracted from the documents
first, and then a graph can be constructed through relation extraction or entity co-occurrence (Edge
et al., 2024); c) ToG-2 achieves new SOTA performances on various complex knowledge reasoning
datasets and can elevate the reasoning capabilities of smaller LLMs, e.g., Llama2-13B to a level
comparable to direct reasoning with powerful LLMs like GPT-3.5.

evidence.quote:
Abstract
In order to thrive in hostile and ever-changing natural environments, mammalian
brains evolved to store large amounts of knowledge about the world and continually
integrate new information while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Despite their
impressive accomplishments, large language models (LLMs), even with retrieval-
augmented generation (RAG), still struggle to efficiently and effectively integrate
a large amount of new experiences after pre-training. In this work, we introduce
HippoRAG, a novel retrieval framework inspired by the hippocampal indexing
theory of human long-term memory to enable deeper and more efficient knowledge
integration over new experiences. HippoRAG synergistically orchestrates LLMs,
knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm to mimic the different
roles of neocortex and hippocampus in human memory. We compare HippoRAG
with existing RAG methods on multi-hop question answering (QA) and show that
our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods remarkably, by up to 20%.
Single-step retrieval with HippoRAG achieves comparable or better performance
than iterative retrieval like IRCoT while being 10-20 times cheaper and 6-13 times
faster, and integrating HippoRAG into IRCoT brings further substantial gains.
Finally, we show that our method can tackle new types of scenarios that are out of
reach of existing methods.1

results.question: 围绕“有限上下文或有限搜索预算下如何保留必要证据”，比较 G-Retriever、Tree-of-Traversals 与 CuriousLLM 的机制。哪些是子图选择，哪些是搜索边界，哪些是证据缺口信号？
results.answer:
G-Retriever 明确把“子图构造”作为流程的一步：检索到语义相关节点和边后，构造一个连通子图，覆盖尽可能多相关节点和边，同时保持图规模可控 [chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]。其子图选择被表述为 PCST 优化问题，并称可借此扩展到超过 LLM 上下文窗口的图 [chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]。

Tree-of-Traversals 维护一个局部 KG 子图并反复扩展，直到包含 LLM 回答查询所需全部信息；算法在 LLM 能利用该局部子图回答原查询时停止 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。它由 KG 接口、定义可行动作/状态/提示模板的动作状态机，以及定义搜索轨迹（如最佳优先搜索、犯错回溯和找到答案时的终止条件）的树搜索算法组成 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。因此这里同时存在“子图扩展”机制和由树搜索终止条件体现的搜索边界，但证据未给出固定预算数值。

CuriousLLM 的遍历算法设有“预设段落预算 K”并初始化检索段落计数，循环在队列耗尽或代理返回空集时终止 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。其代理可生成终止信号“NA”以提前结束遍历，作者称该机制在证据充分时停止搜索，从而减少遍历时间和计算/延迟，并称保持有竞争力的准确率 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。这可视为“证据充分”的终止/缺口信号机制，但证据未说明其如何判定证据不充分或报告缺口。

按所给原文，明确可归为子图选择的是 G-Retriever 的连通子图提取/PCST 子图检索 [chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]；Tree-of-Traversals 是局部子图反复扩展并以树搜索控制轨迹 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]；CuriousLLM 是带段落预算和“NA”提前终止的 KG 遍历 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。搜索边界方面，CuriousLLM 有预设段落预算 K 和空返回终止 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]，Tree-of-Traversals 有树搜索终止条件 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]；G-Retriever 的证据只给出“保持图规模可控”，未给具体预算或停止规则，流程细节证据不足 [chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]。证据缺口信号方面，只有 CuriousLLM 明确以“NA”表示已收集足够证据并终止 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]；其余两者的原文未明确给出“证据缺口”信号。

5
G-Retriever
In this section, we introduce G-Retriever, a new architecture tailored for GraphQA, which integrates
the strengths of GNNs, LLMs, and RAG. To allow efficient fine-tuning while preserving the LLM’s
pretrained language capabilities, we freeze the LLM and use a soft prompting approach on the output
of the GNN. Our RAG-based design mitigates hallucinations through direct retrieval of the graph,
while allowing our approach to scale to graphs exceeding the LLM’s context window size. To adapt
RAG to graphs, we formulate subgraph retrieval as a PCST optimization problem. This approach
also allows us to enhance explainability by returning the retrieved subgraph.
G-Retriever comprises four main steps: indexing, retrieval, subgraph construction and generation, as
depicted in Figure 3. The implementation details of each step are elaborated in the following sections.
5.1
Indexing

Tree-of-Traversals
The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local
KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it
contains all the information required by an LLM
to answer the given query. At the start, a local
KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities
present in the original query. It is then expanded
using a tree search algorithm to choose actions and
thoughts generated by an LLM in order to obtain
relevant knowledge from the KG using a KG inter-
face. The algorithm halts when the LLM is able
to answer the original query using the local KG
subgraph as context. Tree-of-Traversals consists of
three major components. (1) A knowledge graph
interface implemented to interact with one or more
required KGs. (2) An action state machine (ASM)
which is a finite state machine that defines the fea-
sible space of actions, states, and prompt templates
when the LLM interacts with a KG to expand the
local KG subgraph. (3) A tree search algorithm
which defines the overall LLM search trajectory
such as best first search, backtrack upon making a
mistake, and termination condition when an answer
is found.

Tree-of-Traversals
The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local
KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it
contains all the information required by an LLM
to answer the given query. At the start, a local
KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities
present in the original query. It is then expanded
using a tree search algorithm to choose actions and
thoughts generated by an LLM in order to obtain
relevant knowledge from the KG using a KG inter-
face. The algorithm halts when the LLM is able
to answer the original query using the local KG
subgraph as context.

results.answer: 在有限上下文或有限搜索预算下，三者的机制定位不同。G-Retriever 把子图选择作为检索流程中的显式环节：原文称“Subgraph Construction: A connected subgraph is extracted, covering as many relevant nodes and edges as possible while maintaining a manageable graph size”，并把子图检索形式化为 PCST 优化问题，以适配超出 LLM 上下文窗口的图。[chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d] CuriousLLM 展示搜索边界与证据缺口信号：其预设“passage budget K”的遍历算法在检索队列或候选队列耗尽、或智能体返回空集时终止循环，[chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521] 同时微调模型在“gathered sufficient evidence”时生成终止信号“NA”以提前停止搜索，属于证据充分性信号。[chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521] Tree-of-Traversals 的原文证据仅称其为用树搜索增强黑箱 LLM 的零样本 KG 推理算法，未给出有限预算下的子图选择、搜索边界或证据缺口信号的具体机制描述，因此该维度流程证据不足。[chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]

In this section, we introduce G-Retriever, a new architecture tailored for GraphQA, which integrates
the strengths of GNNs, LLMs, and RAG. To allow efficient fine-tuning while preserving the LLM’s

while allowing our approach to scale to graphs exceeding the LLM’s context window size. To adapt

also allows us to enhance explainability by returning the retrieved subgraph.

depicted in Figure 3. The implementation details of each step are elaborated in the following sections.

evidence.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning
paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG
not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs
through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs dur-
ing inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demon-
strate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and
generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results1.

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/059_CuriousLLM Elevating Multi-Document QA with Reasoning-Infused Knowledge Graph Prompting.pdf
evidence.quote:
Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved
significant success in open-domain question an-
swering. However, they continue to face chal-
lenges such as hallucinations and knowledge
cutoffs. These issues can be mitigated through
in-context learning by providing LLMs with
relevant context before generating answers.
Recent literature proposes Knowledge Graph
Prompting (KGP) which integrates knowledge
graphs with an LLM-based traversal agent
to substantially enhance document retrieval
quality. However, KGP requires costly fine-
tuning with large datasets and remains prone
to hallucination. In this paper, we propose
CuriousLLM, an enhancement that integrates
a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into
an LLM agent. This mechanism enables the
agent to generate relevant follow-up questions,
thereby guiding the information retrieval pro-
cess more efficiently. Central to our approach
is the development of the new Follow-upQA
dataset, which includes questions and support-
ing evidence as input, with follow-up ques-
tions serving as ground truths. These follow-
up questions either inquire about what is still
missing to fully answer the user’s query or
use special tokens to signify that the retrieved
evidence is sufficient. Our experiments show
that CuriousLLM significantly boosts LLM per-
formance in multi-document question answer-
ing (MD-QA), circumventing the substantial
computational costs and latency from the orig-
inal KGP framework. Source code: https:
//github.com/zukangy/KGP-CuriousLLM.

Conclusion
In this paper, we try to enhance the planning ability
in retrieval-augmented LLMs using KGs. Specifi-
cally, we design a framework for Learning to Plan
from KG (LPKG). The proposed LPKG framework
first utilizes the rich patterns in the KGs to con-
struct planning data, then fine-tune planning LLMs
based on such data to enable them to conduct plan-
ning on downstream datasets, and ultimately get
the final answer through parsing and execution.
The experimental results reveal the excellent per-
formance of the LPKG framework and also demon-
strate the effectiveness of using KG-sourced data to
enhance LLMs’ planning ability. Finally, we con-
struct CLQA-Wiki, providing a more challenging

the focus of future work.

results.question: 比较 LPKG、CuriousLLM 与 RoG 的训练信号和推理用途：图派生规划数据、问题与支持证据生成追问、KG 支持的关系路径分别属于谁？不能只回答三者都用了 KG。
results.answer:
RoG 将 KG 支持的关系路径作为推理规划与检索用途：RoG 首先生成由 KG 支撑的关系路径作为忠实计划，再用这些计划从 KG 检索有效推理路径供 LLM 推理，并通过训练从 KG 蒸馏知识 [chunk_58e7ae48fdb49536bc066f6e74ccd2a0]。因此，“KG 支持的关系路径”归属 RoG。

LPKG 使用“KG-sourced planning data”进行微调，即其规划数据来自 KG；证据仅说明 LPKG(CodeQwen) 与 LPKG(Llama3) 是在 KG 来源的规划数据上微调的版本 [chunk_0bd33867fd3e8c1883e6ad37bcb38ec6]。因此，“图派生规划数据（KG-sourced planning data）”的训练信号归 LPKG；该证据未描述 LPKG 推理阶段如何使用该规划。

关于 CuriousLLM 的“问题与支持证据生成追问”，所给证据只说明其评估沿用 KGP-T5 设置、将每个段落作为 KG 节点并限制 2-hop 遍历 [chunk_e81a3933dd3c4e99786251f6dbc9b66a]；这不足以证明“问题与支持证据生成追问”属于 CuriousLLM 的训练信号或推理用途，该项归属证据不足。

evidence.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning
paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG
not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs
through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs dur-
ing inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demon-
strate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and
generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results1.

results.answer: ToG 的 LLM 调用上限为 2ND + D + 1，这是“maximal computational complexity”，且“in most cases”不会真正达到，因为推理可能提前停止 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]；ToG-R 的 LLM 调用上限为 ND + D + 1，是“at most”的上限 [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。ToG 因“computational cost (which increases linearly with the depth)”把深度与宽度默认都设为 3 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。关于 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与扩展预算：所给证据只有结论段，未描述其深度、扩展预算或调用上限，因此无法与 ToG/ToG-R 做公式对照 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]。因此不能把 ToG/ToG-R 的上限直接换算成统一运行时排名：ToG 的上限是理论上限而实际平均调用更少，并受提前停止影响 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]；而 Tree-of-Traversals 相关参数与方法流程证据不足 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]。

To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments

with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.

results.question: ToG/ToG-R 的搜索宽度和深度怎样联系到 LLM 调用次数？再与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算对照，说明为什么这些公式/上限不能直接换算成统一运行时排名。
results.answer: ToG 的实验把搜索深度 Dmax 与 beam 宽度 N 作为性能探索变量，并指出计算成本随深度线性增加，因此默认把深度和宽度都设为3；该文还报告在深度超过3后性能增益递减。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644] ToG-R 的调用次数有明示上限：原文称 ToG-R 最多需要 ND + D + 1 次 LLM 调用，并说明 ToG-R 相比 ToG 取消了用 LLM 剪枝实体的步骤，从而降低总体成本与推理时间。[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4] 不过，所给证据没有给出 ToG 本身的显式调用次数公式，也没有把宽度 N 和深度 D 逐项映射到 LLM 调用次数，因此 ToG 的宽度—深度—调用次数关系流程证据不足。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4] 关于 Tree-of-Traversals，所给证据只说明它是使用树搜索的零样本算法、可借助任意数量 KG 增强任意强 LLM，并在结论中强调零示例、无 schema 依赖和无训练；证据中没有给出其深度、扩展预算或调用次数上限的公式。[chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86] 因此，无法依据这些原文把 ToG/ToG-R 的 N、D 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算换算成统一运行时排名；这一比较缺少双方可对照的调用次数与预算定义，属于证据缺口，不能据此判定谁运行时更优。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4][chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]

Then ToG-R performs the reasoning step based on all candidate reasoning paths ending with ED

obtained by entity search. If the LLM determines that the retrieved candidate reasoning paths do not
contain enough information for the LLM to answer the question, we randomly sample N entities
from the candidate entities ED
cand and continue to the next iteration. Assuming that entities in each

n=1 might have little impact on the following relation
exploration. Thus, we use the random beam search instead of the LLM-constrained beam search in

details of the ToG and ToG-R. ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM.
Compared to ToG, ToG-R offers two key benefits: 1) It eliminates the need for the process of pruning

literal information of intermediate entities is missing or unfamiliar to the LLM.

results.answer: ToG 与 ToG-R 的调用次数关系：仅就提供的证据，ToG 本身没有给出显式调用次数公式；ToG-R 的调用上限被原文明确写为“ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM”，并且同一段说明 ToG-R 相对 ToG 省去了用 LLM 剪枝实体这一步骤，因此降低了总体成本与推理时间。[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4] 关于搜索深度与宽度：原文实验将搜索深度 Dmax 与 beam 宽度 N 分别从 1 到 4 变化，并指出计算成本“increases linearly with the depth”，默认把深度和宽度都设为 3；这些是性能/成本设定描述，未据此给出把宽度 N、深度 D 统一折算为 LLM 调用次数的公式。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644] 与 Tree-of-Traversals 对照：提供的 Tree-of-Traversals 证据只有结论段，称其是零样本、无模式依赖、无需训练的算法，并已在多个 LLM 与数据集上实验验证；该段没有给出深度、扩展预算或 LLM 调用次数上限，因此无法与 ToG/ToG-R 的 D、N、ND+D+1 作数值对照，方法层面的换算证据不足。[chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86] 为什么不能直接换算成统一运行时排名：ToG 侧证据只说明成本随深度线性增加以及默认深度/宽度取值，ToG-R 侧只给出“至多 ND + D + 1 次”的上限；Tree-of-Traversals 侧缺少深度、扩展预算与调用次数信息。缺少可比的调用计量与实验条件，且上限不等于实际调用数，故不能据此推出统一运行时排名；这里是基于证据缺口的判断，而非原文给出的排名结论。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.

results.question: 结合 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的 2Wiki/MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 描述，区分“多跳”“交并逻辑”“跨 KG”三种任务关系，并逐项绑定到相应证据。
results.answer: LPKG 将 CLQA-Wiki 描述为覆盖 multi-hop、comparison、intersection、union 四类问题，并指出既有复杂 QA 基准主要关注 multi-hop 与 comparison 而缺少逻辑操作 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。因此按该文，多跳是问题类型之一，交（intersection）与并（union）属于并列的逻辑操作类型，但原文未给出三者的进一步定义 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。Tree-of-Traversals 对 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 的说明是：该数据集含 109 个问题，“require reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata”，即为回答单个问题需综合两个 KG 的信息，并有别于仅含通用知识的 Wikidata，MusicBrainz 是音乐领域的深度专业库 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。该文还称此前没有数据集要求从多个 KG 综合信息以回答单个问题 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。就任务关系的对应而言：多跳一侧有 LPKG 的明确类型覆盖 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]，跨 KG 一侧有 ToT 对 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 的明确描述 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；但 LPKG 的交并逻辑与 ToT 的跨 KG 分属不同基准与不同论文，所给证据未提供二者可比的统一任务分类或定义，故不能据此推断它们之间存在继承、等价或胜负关系。

evidence.quote:
Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

results.question: 结合 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的 2Wiki/MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 描述，区分“多跳”“交并逻辑”“跨 KG”三种任务关系，并逐项绑定到相应证据。
results.answer: LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 被描述为均匀覆盖 multi-hop、comparison、intersection、union 四类问题，其中“交并逻辑”对应 intersection 与 union；原文同时指出既有复杂 QA 基准主要关注多跳和比较类而缺少逻辑操作 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。Tree-of-Traversals 的 2WikiMultiHop 被说明为从 HotPotQA 抽取多跳模板并组合成复杂推理问题，因此可绑定“多跳”证据 [chunk_a8ce6be635ba6abbbc71daeb86e809e9]；其 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 被说明为需要同时使用 MusicBrainz 与 Wikidata 信息进行推理，因此可绑定“跨 KG”，但原文没有把它描述为 intersection 或 union 任务 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。“交并逻辑”在 Tree-of-Traversals 所给证据中未被描述，故该项对 Tree-of-Traversals 侧证据不足；此外证据不足以比较两基准的任务难度或胜负条件。

MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata Dataset One novel
use-case of Tree-of-Traversals is synthesizing and
reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources.
There is no existing dataset that requires synthesiz-
ing information from multiple KGs to answer indi-
vidual questions. Therefore, to test the reasoning
ability using multiple KGs, we create a new dataset,
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata, containing 109 questions
that require reasoning with information from both
MusicBrainz and Wikidata. Unlike Wikidata which
contains general knowledge, MusicBrainz is a deep
domain-specific database on the music industry.
The vast majority of this information is unlikely to
be known by large language models. We construct
the MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata dataset with human
annotators who were provided with instructions
to find reasoning paths between these two KGs,
the question types to focus on, and some example
questions.
